DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 詰め替え用の商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a refill product?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の手洗い用の容器に入れるものを探しています。この写真と同じ商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手洗い用容器の写真に合う詰め替えを探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for something for the handwashing dispenser at home. Do you have the same product as in this photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're looking for a refill matching the photo of your handwashing dispenser. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真では商品名の後半が見えません。別の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: The second half of the product name isn't visible in the photo. Do you have another photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 底の写真ならあります。今手に取った袋と名前が少し違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 底の写真を示して選んだ袋との名前の違いを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of the bottom. The name is a little different from the pouch I just picked up.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the photo of the bottom and point out the name difference from the pouch you chose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは台所用と書かれています。用途の表示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one says it's for kitchen use. Let's check the intended-use label together.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 色が似ていて間違えました。容器に合うものがわからなければ、今日は買わないほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た色で間違えたと述べ不明なら購入を保留したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I got it wrong because the colors are similar. If I can't tell what matches the dispenser, perhaps I shouldn't buy anything today.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say similar colors caused your mistake and you want to hold off buying if unsure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家庭の容器の表示を確認してから選ぶこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check the label on your dispenser at home before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 商品名と用途の写真を撮って、家で見比べてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で比較するため商品名と用途を撮影できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I photograph the product name and intended use so I can compare them at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may photograph the product name and intended use to compare at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店内撮影について担当者に確認します。先に商品名をメモする方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about photography in the store. Another option is to write down the product name first.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではメモにします。容器の表示を読み直してから、詰め替えを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名をメモし家庭の容器表示を再確認してから選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll make a note. I'll reread the dispenser's label before choosing a refill.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll note the product name and recheck the dispenser's label at home before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 棚の表示も写し間違えないようにご確認ください。次回は容器の商品名がわかるものをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the shelf label too, so you don't copy it incorrectly. Next time, bring something that shows the dispenser's product name.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鞄の大きさを見比べていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you comparing the bags' sizes?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎日の通勤に使います。書類が入って、肩に掛けやすいものを探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類が入り肩に掛けやすい通勤用鞄を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll use it for my daily commute. I'm looking for one that holds documents and is easy to carry on my shoulder.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a commuting bag that holds documents and is easy to carry on your shoulder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類の大きさがわかるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have something that shows the size of your documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このファイルです。汚さないように、鞄に当ててみてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参ファイルを使って大きさを確かめたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: This folder. May I hold it against the bag, taking care not to get the bag dirty?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to use the folder you brought to check the size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中へ入れる前に、こちらの見本用ファイルで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before putting it inside, let's check with this sample folder.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入りました。ただ、こちらの鞄は何も入れていなくても少し重いですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類は入るが空の状態でも重いと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: It fits. But this bag feels a little heavy even with nothing in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the documents fit but the bag is heavy even when empty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 素材が異なります。軽いほうも肩に掛けて比べてみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: The materials are different. Would you like to put the lighter one on your shoulder too and compare?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 比べたいです。予算内ですが、持ち手が滑らないかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予算内で軽さと持ち手の滑りを比較したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'd like to compare them. It's within my budget, but I'll also check whether the handles slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it's within budget and you want to compare lightness and whether the handles slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでゆっくりお試しください。鏡の前の通路は空けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take your time trying it here. Could you leave the walkway in front of the mirror clear?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路の横で試します。軽いほうが使いやすいので、こちらに決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空けて試し軽い鞄を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll try it beside the walkway. The lighter one is easier to use, so I'll choose this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll try it without blocking the walkway and choose the lighter bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お選びの鞄を会計へお持ちします。毎日の通勤で使うものですから、持ち心地を確認できてよかったですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take your chosen bag to the checkout. Since it's for daily commuting, it's good that you could check how it feels to carry.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: チェックインのご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to check in?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が予約した部屋に泊まります。私は早く着いたので、荷物だけ預けられるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人名義の予約で先に到着し荷物預かりの可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm staying in a room my friend booked. I've arrived early, so I'd like to ask whether I can leave just my luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you've arrived first for a booking in your friend's name and ask whether luggage can be stored. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご予約名を伺って、同行者として確認できるか調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask for the booking name and check whether we can confirm you as a companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約のメールを友人が転送してくれました。画面を見せても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転送された予約メールの画面を見せてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend forwarded the booking email. Is it all right to show you the screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may show the forwarded booking email on the screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な予約情報だけ拝見します。友人の私的なメッセージは閉じてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll look only at the necessary booking information. Please close your friend's private messages.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約画面だけ開きます。預けるとき、貴重品は自分で持っていればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約画面のみ示し貴重品を自分で持つべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll open only the booking screen. When leaving the luggage, should I keep my valuables with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show only the booking screen and check whether to keep valuables yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 預かれる荷物と注意事項を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check which luggage we can accept and the precautions before explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋の中に壊れやすいお土産もあるので、それは取り出しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: お土産が壊れやすいため荷物から取り出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are fragile souvenirs in the bag too, so I'll take those out.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll remove the souvenirs because they're fragile. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人が到着した際の合流方法も決めてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Have you also decided how to meet your friend when they arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ロビーで会うことにしました。部屋の手続きは友人と一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人とロビーで会い部屋の手続きを一緒に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've decided to meet in the lobby. I'll check the room procedures together with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll meet your friend in the lobby and check the room procedures together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では予約情報の確認を進めます。お出かけになる前に荷物の案内をお受け取りください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll proceed with checking the booking information. Please receive the luggage instructions before going out. Have a good outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時計を見にいらしたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to see the clock?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: からくりを見たいです。友達に、からくりが動いたあとで会おうと言ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: からくりの後に会うと友人に伝えたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the mechanical display. I already told my friend we'd meet after the figures move.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you told your friend you'd meet after the clock's mechanical display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動く時刻は最新の案内で確認してください。お友達はその時刻をご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the latest information for the operating time. Does your friend know that time?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私もまだ確認していません。友達には時間を決めずに連絡していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 動く時刻を確認せず待ち合わせ時刻も決めていなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't checked it yet either. I contacted my friend without settling a meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you hadn't checked the operating time or decided the meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、待ち合わせの時刻と場所を別に決めたほうが安心ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, it's safer to arrange your meeting time and place separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に友達と会ってから、一緒に案内を確認しようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に友人と合流してから案内を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think I'll meet my friend first and then we'll check the information together.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll meet your friend first, then check the information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時計の周りは人が集まることがあります。合流する目印を決められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Crowds sometimes gather around the clock. Can you decide on a landmark for meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計のすぐ下ではなく、この案内板の横を目印にしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時計の直下を避け案内板を目印にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: May we use the side of this information board as a landmark, rather than directly under the clock?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may use the information board as a landmark, avoiding directly beneath the clock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通行の妨げにならない位置でお待ちください。写真に残す際も周囲にご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait where you won't obstruct people passing. When taking a photo, consider those around you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板の写真を送ります。見られない場合は、待ち続けず友達と次の予定を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目印を写真で伝え見られない場合は次の予定を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll send a photo of the information board. If we can't see the display, we won't just keep waiting; I'll discuss our next plans with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll send a landmark photo and discuss your next plans if you can't see the display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない待ち合わせになりましたね。お友達と合流して、道後でのひとときをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's a manageable meeting plan now. Meet up with your friend and enjoy your time in Dogo.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試着した上着の着心地はいかがでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: How did the jacket feel when you tried it on?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肩はちょうどいいのですが、袖が長くて手が隠れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肩は合うが袖が長く手を覆うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shoulders fit, but the sleeves are long and cover my hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the shoulders fit but the long sleeves cover your hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一つ小さいサイズも試してみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like to try one size smaller too?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。腕を動かしたときにきつくならないか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さいサイズで腕を動かして窮屈さを確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I'd like to check that it doesn't feel tight when I move my arms.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to move your arms in the smaller size to check for tightness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 試着室で動きをご確認ください。袖を折る場合はこちらの鏡も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check your movements in the fitting room. You can also use this mirror if you fold the sleeves.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいほうは背中がきついです。大きいほうを買うなら、交換の条件を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さいサイズがきついため大きいサイズの交換条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: The smaller one is tight across my back. If I buy the larger one, I'd like to know the exchange conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the smaller size is tight and ask about exchange conditions for the larger one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この練習店舗の条件を書いた紙をお渡しします。気になる項目を一緒に読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give you a sheet with this practice store's conditions. Let's read the points you're concerned about together.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この「タグを外した場合」という部分を説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: タグを外した場合という記載の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you explain this part that says 'if the tag has been removed'?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the wording 'if the tag has been removed' means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: タグの状態が条件に関わるという意味です。購入前に担当者へ具体的な扱いを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: It means the tag's condition affects the terms. Before buying, let's ask the person in charge how it specifically applies.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で切ってからでは遅いかもしれませんね。今日は条件を確認して、購入は考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: タグを切る前の条件を確認し今日は購入を再検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: It might be too late after cutting it off at home. I'll check the conditions today and reconsider buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the conditions before cutting the tag and say you'll reconsider buying today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 紙をお持ちになり、ご自分に合う着心地を優先してご検討ください。またお立ち寄りくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the sheet and consider your options, prioritizing a comfortable fit. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の文章をご覧になって、気になった点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: After reading the exhibit text, is there anything you're wondering about?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この文章をノートに写したいのですが、作品そのものですか、それとも説明ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写したい文が作品原文か解説か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to copy this passage into my notebook. Is it the work itself or an explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the passage you want to copy is the work's original text or commentary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用展示では、上段が作品の引用で、下段が解説です。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this learning exhibit, the upper section is a quotation from the work and the lower section is commentary.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ枠にあるので混同しました。二つを分けてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ枠で混同したため引用と解説を分けて書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I confused them because they're in the same box. I'll take separate notes for the two.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you confused them in the same box and will write the quotation and commentary separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録する際は、展示名も書いておくとあとで見直しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: When recording it, writing the exhibit's name too makes it easier to review later.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展示名を控えました。読めない字だけ写真に撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展示名を記録し読めない文字の撮影可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've noted the exhibit's name. May I photograph just the characters I can't read?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the exhibit's name and ask whether you may photograph unreadable characters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影の可否は展示ごとの表示を確認してください。この箇所は担当者へ照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the photography signs for each exhibit. Let's ask the person in charge about this particular part.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 禁止されていたら、読めない字を教えてもらう方法でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影禁止なら読めない字を教えてもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: If photography is prohibited, I'm also happy to have someone tell me the characters I can't read.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'd like help reading the characters if photography is prohibited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当者に伝えます。ほかの来館者の通り道は空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that request to the person in charge. Please keep other visitors' path clear while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 少し横へ移動します。解説を自分の言葉でまとめてから、次の展示へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け解説を自分の言葉でまとめて次へ進むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move a little to the side. I'll summarize the commentary in my own words before going to the next exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll leave the path clear, summarize the commentary in your own words, and move on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 作品と解説の区別ができましたね。ノートを見返しながら、残りの展示もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: You can distinguish the work from the commentary now. Enjoy the remaining exhibits while looking back at your notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行案内についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about train service information?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が迎えに来るので、電車の遅れを知らせたいです。どの情報を見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えに来る家族へ遅れを知らせるため見るべき情報を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family is coming to pick me up, so I'd like to tell them about the train delay. Which information should I look at?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what information to check to tell the family picking you up about the delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の案内画面には、更新した時刻と現在の状況が表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: This learning display shows the update time and current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 更新時刻はわかりましたが、到着時刻はまだ書いてありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 更新時刻はあるが到着時刻がないと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see the update time, but there's no arrival time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out that there's an update time but no arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ到着時刻は示されていません。今の表示から、具体的な到着時刻は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: An arrival time hasn't been shown yet. You can't determine a specific arrival time from the current display.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では「何時に着く」とは言わず、遅れているとだけ家族に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着時刻を断定せず遅延中という状況を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't say what time I'll arrive; I'll just tell my family the train is delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll report the delay without stating a definite arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況が変わったら連絡すると添えておくとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to add that you'll contact them if the situation changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 迎えの場所も、運行情報を確認してから決め直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運行情報を見て家族と迎えの場所を決め直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd also like to decide the pickup location again after checking the service information.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check service information and decide the pickup location again with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族と相談なさってください。移動先を変更する場合も最新の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss that with your family. If you change where you're going, check the latest information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず今の状況を送り、安全な場所で待って、次の更新を見てから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な場所で更新を待って家族へ再連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll send the current situation, wait in a safe place, and contact them after looking at the next update.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait safely for an update and contact your family again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 周囲の通行に気をつけてお待ちください。ご家族との連絡が取れたら、落ち着いてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please be mindful of people passing while you wait. Once you've contacted your family, take your time going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前に何か確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵にアレルギーがあります。麺やスープに卵を使っているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーと麺やスープの材料確認の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. I'd like to check whether the noodles or soup contain egg.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your egg allergy and wish to check the noodle and soup ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 材料表を見ますが、仕込み済みのスープは担当者への確認も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll look at the ingredient list, but the soup prepared earlier also needs checking with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上に載る卵を外すだけでは判断できないので、麺とスープも調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: トッピングを外すだけでなく麺とスープを調べるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just removing the egg on top isn't enough to tell, so please check the noodles and soup too.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the noodles and soup, rather than just remove the topping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できた内容だけお伝えします。調理器具の共用についても確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell you only what we've confirmed. Shall we also check shared cooking utensils?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 器具についてもお願いします。同じ器具を使うかも知りたいです。急いで答えてもらわなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共用器具も確認し回答を急がなくてよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check the utensils too. I'd like to know whether the same equipment is used. You don't have to rush the answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check shared utensils too and say there's no need to rush the answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現時点ではスープの一部の材料が確認できていません。安全とはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: At present, some of the soup ingredients haven't been confirmed. We can't tell you it's safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 不明な点が残るなら、今回は注文を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認の材料が残るため注文を控えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there are still unanswered questions, I'll refrain from ordering this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll refrain from ordering because some ingredients remain unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回はご注文を見送られるのですね。確認が不十分なままおすすめすることはいたしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: You're deciding not to order this time, then. We won't recommend anything while the checks are incomplete.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 調べてくださってありがとうございます。同行者にも話して、別の食事を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認への感謝を伝えて同行者と別の食事を考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you for looking into it. I'll talk to my companion and consider another meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank them for checking and say you'll consider another meal with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご判断を尊重します。お連れ様と相談なさってください。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: We respect your decision. Please discuss it with your companion. Take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は表示された範囲の清掃を担当してください。開始前に確認することはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please clean the marked area today. Is there anything to check before starting?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 担当場所へ行く通路に板が積まれていて、通れそうにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 担当場所への通路を積まれた板が塞いでいると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Boards are stacked on the path to my assigned area, and it doesn't look passable.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say stacked boards are blocking the path to your assigned area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの通路ですか。安全な場所から位置を説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which path is it? Explain the location from a safe place.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から見て右側の通路です。今は手前の待機場所にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 障害が入口右側で自分は手前の待機場所にいると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the path on the right when viewed from the entrance. I'm now at the waiting point before it.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that the obstruction is to the right of the entrance and you're at the waiting point before it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そこから先へ進まず、資材も動かさないでください。責任者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't go any farther or move the materials. I'll check with the supervisor.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で片づけようかと思いましたが、触らずに待ちます。清掃もまだ始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資材に触らず清掃を始めず待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I might clear them myself, but I'll wait without touching them. I won't start cleaning yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll wait without touching the materials or starting cleaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままお待ちください。別の作業場所へ移る指示が出る可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep waiting there. You may be instructed to move to another work location.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移る場合は、担当する範囲と入ってよい経路をもう一度確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動時には新しい範囲と許可された経路を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I move, I'd like to recheck my assigned area and the permitted route.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if you move, you want to check the new area and permitted route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい指示が出たら、図を使って説明します。聞き取れない点はその場で質問してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: When new instructions are issued, I'll explain using a diagram. Ask on the spot about anything you can't catch.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 経路が決まるまで待機します。変更後は説明を復唱してから作業を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経路決定まで待ち変更後の指示を復唱して開始すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait until the route is decided. After the change, I'll repeat the instructions before starting work.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait until the route is set and repeat the changed instructions before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できるまで待つという判断で結構です。私は責任者へ連絡します。合図があるまで、この待機場所でお待ちください。確認後にまた声をかけますので、ひとまず失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Waiting until it's confirmed is the right decision. I'll contact the supervisor. Stay at this waiting point until signaled. I'll speak to you again after checking, so I'll leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss a new account?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事を始めたので給与用の口座を作りたいです。でも会社の指定があるか、まだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座を希望するが会社の指定をまだ聞いていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've started working and want to open an account for my salary. But I haven't asked whether my company has any requirements yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a salary account but haven't asked about company requirements yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先が求める情報を確認すると、申込みの相談を進めやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking what information your employer requires will make it easier to discuss the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社には銀行名だけでなく、どんなことを聞けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行名以外に会社へ確認すべき情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Apart from the bank's name, what should I ask the company?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask what to check with the company besides the bank's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会社側の担当者に、指定の有無と提出する口座情報をお尋ねください。開設条件はこちらで別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask the company's person in charge whether they specify a bank or account and which account details to submit. We'll check the account-opening requirements separately here.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の条件と銀行の条件は別なんですね。持ってきた書類も見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社と銀行の条件を区別して持参書類の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: The company and bank requirements are separate, then. Could you look at the documents I brought too?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish company and bank requirements and ask to check the documents you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が必要な情報を確認しますが、今ある書類だけで開設できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the necessary information, but you may not be able to open an account with just the documents you have now.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 足りないものがあれば、正式な書類名を紙に書いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足りない書類の正式名称を紙で示してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: If anything is missing, I'd like the official document names written on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the official names of missing documents on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を担当者へ伝えます。今日は申込みを進めたいですか、準備の相談までにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that request to the person in charge. Would you like to proceed with an application today, or just discuss preparation?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は準備の相談にします。会社の指定を確認してから、申込みを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は準備相談にとどめ会社の指定後に申込みを考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll just discuss preparation today. I'll consider applying after checking the company's requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say today is only for preparation advice and you'll consider applying after checking the company's requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認事項を整理して担当者に引き継ぎます。勤務先への確認後、不明な点があればまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll organize the points to check and hand over to the person in charge. After checking with your employer, please consult us again if anything is unclear.
